notes.title: Update to v1.5 for new speech synthesizer and other improvements
notes.notes:
Library:

[list]
[*]Added a [b]SAY[/b] function to synthesize speech
[/list]

Editor:

[list]
[*]Added a [b]PICK_DIRECTORY_DIALOG[/b] function to scriptable plugin
[*]Added [b]GET_ASSETS[/b], [b]OPEN_ASSETS[/b] functions to scriptable plugin

notes.title: Update to v1.4.9 for new graphics commands and other improvements
notes.notes:

notes.title: Update to v1.4 for new functions and improvements
notes.notes:
Visible and sensible changes:

[list]
  [*]Add a switch of automatic frame buffer clearing
  [*]Add a [b]CLS[/b] function to clear frame buffer manually
  [*]Add a [b]SET_CLEARER[/b] function to set the switch of automatic frame buffer clearing
  [*]Fix a termination issue with music
[/list]

Transparent changes:

[list]
  [*]Update many 3rd-party libraries
  [*]Fix a state checking bug with right mouse click
  [*]Fix an accuracy issue with the [b]TOUCH[/b] function
[/list]

notes.title: Update to v1.3.4 for new audio functions and lots of improvements
notes.notes:

  [*]Add an ID type to sound effect

  [*]Fix a tag setting bug with undo operation in the sprite editor
  [*]Fix an unsaved state issue with new created assets
[/list]

notes.title: Update to v1.1 to share via Workshop, get new programming libraries, and more other improvements!

[list]
    [*]Add tools for Steam Workshop
    [*]Add indicator of unsaved file
    [*]Add non-referenced vector and matrix data types, with operators and functions
    [*]Add a path finding algorithm
    [*]Fix a running issue under offline mode with Steam
[/list]

Transparent changes:

[list]
    [*]Add a dedicated file type for customized data
    [*]Fix a parsing bug with the unary negative operator
    [*]Fix a real number parsing bug with different locales
